metadata.abstract: © Springer Science+Business Media, LLC, part of Springer Nature 2020.Accurate prediction of discontinuous antigenic epitopes is important for immunologic research and medical applications, but it is not an easy problem. Currently, there are only a few prediction servers available, though discontinuous epitopes constitute the majority of all B-cell antigenic epitopes. In this chapter, we describe two online servers, EPCES and EPSVR, for discontinuous epitope prediction. All methods were benchmarked by a curated independent test set, in which all antigens had no complex structures with the antibody, and their epitopes were identified by various biochemical experiments. The servers and all datasets are available at http://sysbio.unl.edu/EPCES/ and http://sysbio.unl.edu/EPSVR/.
metadata.title: EPCES and EPSVR: Prediction of B-Cell antigenic epitopes on protein surfaces with conformational information
